title: plugin-ui: Declarative widget-tree UI model (ViewNode)
summary: The serializable widget tree plugins author, SwiftUI/Flutter-style — a container node holds a vector of child widgets — plus the host mapper that realizes it into the retained heca-grid-ui tree. Gate/consumers: the rich overlay body (plugin-task-15), config-plugin render (plugin-task-21), and the WASM contribution description (plugin-task-26) all build on this. Source: pluggable-chrome-plugin-plan.md §2.6.1–2.6.2.
description: ViewNode { kind, props, events, children } + PropValue + Intent, all serde-serializable (WASM-ready). WidgetKind covers the WHOLE grid-ui vocabulary. Behaviour is Intent-only (no closures) so it stays serializable for native AND plugin/WASM. Includes the surface compositor + LayerRegistry (layered-surface architecture for KeyHint visibility) and the OverlayHost (open_modal/resolve).

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-1 — ViewNode model + PropValue + Intent
tasks.description: ViewNode { kind, props, events, children } (events press/change) + PropValue (scalars + semantic enums ViewSize/ViewVariant/ViewAlign, colors/glyphs as names) + Intent(action id + args), all serde-serializable (JSON round-trip test = WASM-ready). WidgetKind covers the WHOLE grid-ui vocabulary (containers + ItemGroup/DockFrame/MarkerGroup/Tabs + all leaves). Behaviour is Intent-only (no closures) so it stays serializable for native AND plugin/WASM. Files: heca/src/chrome/view.rs.

tasks.title: plugin-ui core execution — InteractionIntent::View + OverlayHost + confirm migration
tasks.description: Design §2.7.2 executed end to end: (1) InteractionIntent::View + router/dispatch arm + dispatch_view_intent (interaction.rs); (2) realize (chrome/realize.rs); (3) WmAction::SubmitOverlay/CloseOverlay + OverlayHost::open_modal/resolve (chrome/overlay.rs, built on LayerRegistry); (4) confirm dialog migrated to a Dialog layer with hintable buttons (closes sidebar-fu-13 Stage 3). Overlay-control actions carry overlay: OverlayId (=LayerId), injected by the host, intercepted in dispatch_intent.

tasks.title: Surface compositor + LayerRegistry (step 1)
tasks.description: docs/surface-compositor.md = layered-surface architecture deciding KeyHint visibility (active-context + geometric occlusion, no hardcoded z). active_hint_targets (chrome/mod.rs) builds the on-screen surface stack (overlays → chrome → panes) and resolves it; replaced the three interim geometric filters. LayerRegistry (chrome/layers.rs) holds dynamically-added layers (band/kind/modal). Referenced from AGENTS.md + README.md.

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-3 — realize() mapper
tasks.description: realize(&ViewNode, emit, hints) -> Box<dyn Component> — recursive; Column/Row→Flex, Label, Button (+ empty-container fallback for kinds filled in incrementally), props resolved, actionable node → hint_target + on_click→emit(View intent). Box<dyn Component> is NOT Component → realized children pushed onto base_mut().children (or Dialog::body_boxed), not .child(box). Prop readers total (untrusted input).

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-4 — Dialog widget + rich modal bodies
tasks.description: LARGELY DONE for the modal case: added heca-grid-ui::Dialog (real body + real action Button children; scrim/centering/focus-trap; self-contained keyboard). OverlayHost::open_modal takes ModalSpec { title, body: ViewNode, actions }, realizes the body via realize, builds it into a Dialog layer. Showcase demo + docs/widgets.md §Dialog added. REMAINING: rich bodies with N arbitrary widgets marshalling data back into ModalResult::Action{data} (only text bodies today); a Table widget (plugin-task-ui-5) when a real consumer needs it.

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-2 — Typed SwiftUI-style builder SDK
tasks.description: Typed, SwiftUI-style builder SDK that emits ViewNode (Column::new().gap(8).child(...)). Ergonomic authoring layer over the uniform node; the WASM SDK re-exports it.

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-5 — Table widget (on demand)
tasks.description: On demand: add a first-class Table widget to heca-grid-ui (columns/header/row-selection/sort) + showcase + docs/widgets.md + a mapper arm. Until a real consumer needs it, a table is composed from Grid/Row/Label.

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-6 — Author docs
tasks.description: Author docs: a docs/plugin-authoring.md with detailed ViewNode examples (panel, complex table, modal with a form) + a short "Plugins (upcoming)" pointer in README.md. Must be clearly marked design / target Phase 9 — not yet available until the WASM runtime (plugin-08) ships.

tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-7 — Composition-first widgets (every widget accepts a ViewNode)
tasks.description: EVERY widget must be able to receive a ViewNode (arbitrary child subtree) as its content — the real SwiftUI/Flutter model. Scope: (1) make grid-ui widgets composition-first (accept arbitrary child Component/subtree, not only scalar props; start with Label/Button/IconButton/Badge/Tag then generalize); (2) complete realize() coverage so every WidgetKind maps to its widget (no empty fallback); (3) result: any ViewNode renders, any widget can host any widget. Related direction: rename overlay panel to base Overlay widget with Modal/Dialog as specializations (composition not inheritance); blocking stays a layer property; fold in overlay sizing (.panel_size) + scrollable body (ScrollRegion) gaps. Formalize as its own phase before touching overlay widgets. Update showcase + docs/widgets.md; read all styling from theme; keep vocabulary host-owned. Direction locked with user 2026-07-08.
